Consumer durables stocks rise amid market gains and analyst upgrades

Shares of consumer durables companies, including Godrej Consumer Products, saw an increase in trading on the stock market. This rise was partly attributed to an analyst upgrade for Godrej Consumer Products, which boosted investor confidence. The broader market also traded higher, contributing to the positive sentiment in the sector.
